form.label: Search Performance Validation
form.description: Validate Hi_ED DC1 flat macros vs DC2 map macros (metric parity) and mr_data_gen scheduler load. Default -4h window. PASS = 16 hosts per DC, equal host counts, and data present. MySQL: compare presence only (DC1 uses unstable flat; DC2 uses stable).

html.h3: Section A: EDU DC flat vs map
html.p: Compare Hi_ED DC 1 Generator (flat macros, no map) to Hi_ED DC 2 Generator (legacy map macros). Both should expose the same 16 entity hosts and similar ingestion volume.

search.query: | mstats count as pts WHERE index=itsi_im_metrics metric_name=* (host=EDU_DC_1_* OR host=EDU_DC_2_*) BY host | rex field=host "EDU_DC_(?<dc>[12])_" | stats dc(host) as host_count sum(pts) as total_pts BY dc | eval dc_label=if(dc=1, "DC1_flat", "DC2_map") | eventstats max(host_count) as max_hosts min(host_count) as min_hosts | eval status=if(host_count>=16 AND total_pts>0 AND max_hosts=min_hosts, "PASS", "CHECK") | table dc_label host_count total_pts status

| mstats count WHERE index=itsi_im_metrics metric_name=* (host=EDU_DC_1_* OR host=EDU_DC_2_*) BY host | rex field=host "EDU_DC_(?<dc>[12])_(?<role>.+?)_(?<num>\d+)$" | eval key=role."_".num | stats dc(dc) as dcs values(dc) as which_dc BY key | where dcs<2 | sort key

panel.title: Host and Datapoint Counts by Role

search.query: | mstats count as datapoints WHERE index=itsi_im_metrics metric_name=* (host=EDU_DC_1_* OR host=EDU_DC_2_*) BY host | rex field=host "EDU_DC_(?<dc>[12])_(?<role>.+?)_(?<num>\d+)$" | eval dc_label=if(dc=1, "DC1_flat", "DC2_map") | stats dc(host) as hosts sum(datapoints) as total_pts BY dc_label role | sort role dc_label

| mstats count as samples WHERE index=itsi_im_metrics metric_name=processmon.cpu.percent (host=EDU_DC_1_Authorization_01 OR host=EDU_DC_2_Authorization_01) BY host span=5m | eval dc=case(host="EDU_DC_1_Authorization_01", "DC1_flat", host="EDU_DC_2_Authorization_01", "DC2_map", 1=1, "other") | timechart span=5m sum(samples) by dc

html.h3: Section B: Scheduler and search performance
html.p: Pre-optimize baseline (~4h): inline runs ~47k, inline run-seconds ~8.5k. Post-optimize target: well below baseline. Hi_ED DC generators ~12 runs/hour in demo window (*/5 8-18 Mon-Fri).

search.query: index=_audit action=search info=completed app=mr_data_gen | stats count avg(total_run_time) as avg_s sum(total_run_time) as total_s by savedsearch_name | sort - count
index=_audit action=search info=completed app=mr_data_gen savedsearch_name="" | timechart span=15m count
index=_internal source=*scheduler.log* "Skipping execution" | rex field=_raw "reason=(?<reason>[^,]+)" | stats count by reason
